question: Which is the busiest sea port in Europe?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Rotterdam__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Port of Rotterdam is the biggest port Situated in **Europe.** It is the sixth biggest in the world as per annual cargo throughput.
 
• **Rotterdam** is a major port city located in the Dutch province of South Holland(Europe).
 
• **Rotterdam** is the world's largest seaport which is located outside of East Asia.
 
• From the year **1962 until 2004,** Rotterdam was the **world's busiest port by annual cargo** tonnage capacity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__.**

 
• **Southampton **is Europe’s second-largest seaport, after **Rotterdam.**
 
• The **Port of Southampton **is a passenger and cargo port also located in the central part of the south coast of England(Britain).
